2. In the function `M_Quit_Draw`, a similar modification has been made where `m_state` is assigned the value of `m_quit_prevstate` with the same conditional casting based on the compiler being used.

### Relationships
The modifications in `NQ/menu.c` are related to fixing a compile error that arose from an undeclared identifier `m_state_enum` when compiling with MinGW. The patch introduces conditional compilation directives (`#ifdef _MSC_VER`) to ensure that the explicit cast to `m_state_enum` is only included when compiling with MSVC, thus preventing the error in other environments while maintaining compatibility across different compilers.
